scientific_integrity: An analytic proof uses an exhaustive edge-orbit reduction and convex subgradient certificates. Finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Previously published endpoint and general-inequality results are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the real affine-regular hexagonal plane and outer power-mean exponent two; no claim for arbitrary Banach planes, other exponents or complex analogues. Independent scientific validation has not been performed; an unindexed equivalent formulation remains possible.
title: A sharp phase transition for the quadratic skew Schäffer constant on the affine-regular hexagon
